title: Cassette-CMF Blocks configuration
description: IDE-tooling schema for the array/JSON shape accepted by CassetteCMFBlocks::register_from_array()/register_from_json(). This is documentation only — the runtime validator is Json\Block_Schema_Validator, which reads valid control types from Schema\Control_Catalog::get_registered_types() and valid areas from Schema\Area_Resolver::known_areas() at run time, and is authoritative when the two disagree. "type" is deliberately left as an open string here rather than a closed enum, precisely because the parent library's own schema.json hardcodes such an enum and has drifted out of sync with its runtime validator as a result — see this repository's CHANGELOG.md and docs/RELEASE.md. This file covers only what is implemented so far.

editor_scope.description: Compiled into a single allowed_block_types_all filter. See docs/block-config-reference.md.

content.description: Raw WordPress comment-delimited block HTML. Wins over "blocks" when both are present.

blocks.description: A declarative { blockName, attrs, innerBlocks } tree, serialized into the same shape "content" would be.

args.description: Block.json-shaped keys, checked against an allow-list: apiVersion, title, category, description, icon, keywords, textdomain, parent, ancestor, allowedBlocks, blockHooks, providesContext, usesContext, selectors, supports, styles, variations, variation_callback (PHP arrays only), example, plus the asset keys below. Unknown keys are dropped with a _doing_it_wrong() notice at registration. Block_Definition translates the camelCase keys to the snake_case properties WP_Block_Type reads. apiVersion defaults to 3 and supports.html defaults to false for dynamic blocks when not set.

editorScript.description: Registered script handle(s) loaded in the editor. Maps to editor_script_handles.

editorStyle.description: Registered style handle(s) loaded in the editor. Maps to editor_style_handles.

script.description: Registered script handle(s) loaded in the editor and on the front end. Maps to script_handles.

style.description: Registered style handle(s) loaded in the editor and on the front end. Maps to style_handles.

viewScript.description: Registered script handle(s) loaded on the front end when the block is rendered. Maps to view_script_handles.

viewStyle.description: Registered style handle(s) loaded on the front end when the block is rendered. Maps to view_style_handles.

viewScriptModule.description: Registered script module ID(s) loaded on the front end when the block is rendered. Maps to view_script_module_ids.

attributes.description: Pure-data attributes with no control: name => WP attribute schema ({type, default, enum, ...}). Merged with field-derived attributes; a name collision between the two is an error.

render.description: "mode": "dynamic" (default), "static", or "none". See docs/markup-templates.md and docs/static-save.md for "markup"/"callback"/"template", not fully re-modeled here yet.

deprecated.description: Previous versions of the block. Static: { markup, attributes?, migrate? }. Dynamic: { attributes, migrate } (migrate_php is a PHP callable and cannot appear in JSON). See docs/static-save.md.

migrate.description: A registered migration name, or a declarative migration.

when.description: A { relation, rules } condition (the conditions shape). While false the editor shows a placeholder instead of the preview. Rules of the form { source: 'block', ref } are ignored.

placeholder.description: The <Placeholder> shown for placeholder-area fields while the block is unconfigured. See docs/block-config-reference.md.

when.description: A { relation, rules } condition: true means unconfigured. Default: every required placeholder field is empty.

document_scope.description: Required whenever a field resolves to the document/document.status/document.excerpt/document.publish.pre/document.publish.post/sidebar/more_menu area. See docs/block-config-reference.md.

transforms.description: Transforms: block-to-block remaps, and shortcode / raw transforms backed by a PHP callback. See docs/block-config-reference.md.

assetHandles.description: A registered handle or module ID, or a non-empty list of them. block.json "file:" paths are not supported: register the asset yourself and pass its handle.

transform.description: type "block": needs blocks (+ map). type "shortcode": needs tag + callback. type "raw": needs selector + callback. The callback is a PHP callable, so shortcode / raw entries exist in PHP configs only.

selector.description: type raw: a CSS selector string, or a rule { tag, class, attrs }.

name.description: Must be unique among all value-bearing fields in the block — they share one flat block-attribute namespace.

type.description: Control type. Validated at runtime against Control_Catalog::get_registered_types(), not against a closed list here.

cmf_type.description: Optional override of which parent field type provides sanitize()/validate() reuse via Compat\Cmf_Bridge.

area.description: Dot-notation "<surface>[.<group>]", e.g. "inspector.styles", "toolbar.block", "canvas". Inherited from the nearest enclosing container when omitted; defaults to "inspector" at the top level. Validated against Area_Resolver::known_areas().

source.description: "attribute" (the default) produces a block attribute; "meta" registers real post/term/user/comment meta (see docs/meta-binding.md) and requires a "meta" config; "context" reads a read-only value from block context and requires "context" (no attribute is created); "none" is excluded from the attribute schema.

context.description: Only meaningful (and required) when "source" is "context": the block-context key to read, e.g. "example/formId". Added to the block's usesContext automatically.

ancestor.description: ancestor_field only (required): the block name of the ancestor whose descendants are listed, e.g. "vendor/form".

blocks.description: ancestor_field only: optional allow-list of block names.

has_attribute.description: ancestor_field only: list only blocks whose attribute of this name is non-empty.

name_attribute.description: ancestor_field only: the attribute holding a block's reference name. Default "name".

label_attribute.description: ancestor_field only: the attribute shown as the label. Default "label".

exclude_self.description: ancestor_field only: leave the block itself out. Default true.

conditions.description: conditions control only (optional): lets a rule target another block by its name. Same options as ancestor_field (ancestor is required).

unique.description: text/email/url only. true: unique across the whole post. Object: { scope: "post" | "ancestor", block?: "vendor/form" (required for ancestor), key?: uniqueness group, defaults to the field name }.

meta.description: Only meaningful when "source" is "meta". See docs/meta-binding.md.

value_type.description: Overrides the control type's inferred WP attribute schema type.

options.description: Either a value => label map (the parent library's convention) or a list of { value, label } objects; the list form is normalized to the map at compile time. Produces an "enum" of the option values in the attribute schema (on "items" for an array attribute).

enum.description: Explicit enum, used when "options" isn't a natural fit for the control.

role.description: WP attribute "role" (e.g. "content"), passed through when set.

fields.description: Child fields, for container control types (panel, tab_panel, group, row, stack, toolbar_group, repeater).
